g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-212 Bin screw feeder (built in house, 9 off) · rev B
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: 1 Barrel weldment hung on the bin flange
2 Screw slid in from the tail end
3 Drive housing + shaft into the end flange
6 Sleeve to the hopper lid stub
orange = parts added in that step; ghosted = parts still to come
spigot fully seated, no gap at the collar
H3 x4 + H4 x4 M6, 8 N·m; H10 5 N·m
coupling gap 1.6 [1/16 in]; turn by hand
spout centred on the lid stub ±3; barrel level ±1°
screw turns by hand with the motor fan; no rub
clamp nut hand-tight + 1/4 turn with a wrench
cap seated; tool needed to open
sleeve slack 10 [.4]: hopper weight not carried
1. Step 1: Bench: assemble the drive cartridge: bearings + spacers on the shaft (DIN 471 both), into housing from the rear, DIN 472, pin H5 pressed, lip seal from the front (grease H1).
2. Step 2: Bench: O-ring P1-243 in the housing face; housing onto the barrel end flange recess.
3. Step 3: Bench: lantern onto the housing rear flange; coupling hubs on both shafts (keys H8, set screws H10); gearmotor into the lantern spigot.
4. Step 4: Plant: gasket P1-212-501 on the bin flange, lift the feeder (≈ 25 kg [55 lb], 2 people), spout over the lid port, bolt up.
5. Step 5: Slide the screw in from the tail end, slot over the drive pin (turn the screw until it drops on).
6. Step 6: Tail bush + cap P1-212-306 with gasket P1-246, hex-nut clamp P1-247.
7. Step 7: Sleeve P1-214 over the spout and the lid stub, 2 band clamps.
8. Step 8: Guards P1-212-404 on the lantern; isolator P1-248 on the ring leg; wire per E01/E02.
9. Step 9: Commission per P1-212-900 (rotation, enable, Modbus, calibration).
CLEANING / ALLERGEN CHANGEOVER (about 15 min per feeder)
1. Lock out isolator Q-21n (P1-248) and try the HMI start: the feeder must not run.
2. Open the tail clamp with a wrench; remove the cap with the bush (catch the powder in a scoop; vacuum, never blow).
3. Pull the screw straight out of the tail end (5.8 kg, 1.2 m long); lay it on the cleaning rack, not the floor.
4. Barrel: brush from the tail end with the 2.5 in brush on a rod; wipe; the inlet is reached from the bin side when the bin is empty.
5. Allergen changeover: wash screw, cap, bush in the sink (warm detergent, rinse, sanitise, air dry); dry barrel with the swab; ATP swab the screw (ITP T25).
6. Refit in reverse (steps 5, 6). The drive end is never opened for cleaning: the lip seal keeps product out of the bearings.

lantern front plate to housing rear flange (tapp
